ru.dark mode_tooltip: Фоны лагерей будут соответствовать режиму: ночной - для тёмной темы и дневной - для светлой.
ru.fullscreen scaling_tooltip: Если включено, то в полноэкранном режиме будет отображаться максимально возможный размер (переключите полноэкранный режим для обновления). При этом могут возникать визуальные артефакты.
ru.no sprite antialiasing_tooltip: Если включено, спрайты и патрульные арты больше не будут сглаживаться в полноэкранном режиме.
ru.custom cursor_tooltip: Курсор будет заменен на кошачью лапу. В настоящее время курсор не доработан и склонен к сбоям.
ru.keybinds_tooltip: Позволяет использовать определенные комбинации клавиш в меню для быстрой навигации.
ru.shaders_tooltip: Добавит слой затенения к спрайтам кошки.
ru.gore: Показывать жестокость и кровь в патрульные арты
ru.gore_tooltip: Умеренная жестокость и кровь будут разрешены в арты, вывешенных рядом с патрулями.
ru.discord_tooltip: Discord будет показыывать инфо о вашем Племени, включая его название
ru.show_changelog_tooltip: Показывает журнал изменений последней версии при запуске
ru.special_dates_tooltip: Некоторые изменения могут вноситься в игру в особые дни, например на Первое Апреля.
ru.random relation: Randomize relationship values when creating Clan
ru.random relation_tooltip: Clan founder cats will start the game with established relationships.
ru.they them default: Использовать они/их как местоимений по умолчанию
ru.they them default_tooltip: Если включено, новые кошки будут генерироваться с местоимениями они/их, независимо от пола.
ru.autosave_tooltip: Автоматически сохраненяет игру каждые пять лун
ru.disasters_tooltip: Это может привести к тому, что за одну луну погибнет 1/3 кота вашего Племени.
ru.showxp: Показать точный уровень Опыта и Голода
ru.showxp_tooltip: Will turn 'experience: proficient' into 'experience: proficient (151)'; and 'nutrition: full' into 'nutrition: full (70)'.
ru.random med cat: Разрешить целителя выбрать в случайный потруль
ru.random med cat_tooltip: Целителей можно выбрать с помощью кнопок патруля +1, +3, +6.
ru.fading_tooltip: Через 202 луны мертвые кошки будут выгружены и сохранены отдельно. Семейные отношения не будут потеряны.
ru.save_faded_copy: Сохранить полную копию информации о выцветших кошках
ru.save_faded_copy_tooltip: Полная копия информации о сохранении кошки будет сохранена в открытом виде.
ru.backgrounds_tooltip: .Even with this off, the camp you choose will still affect the events you encounter
ru.moons and seasons: Показать колличтосво лун и время года
ru.moons and seasons_tooltip: Отображает возраст Племени и текущий сезон на нескольких страницах.
ru.deputy: Разрешить Предвотдителю самим выбрать нового Глашатого
ru.deputy_tooltip: При выборе Глашатого будут учитываться правила Воинского Закона.
ru.12_moon_graduation_tooltip: All apprentices will graduate at 12 moons.
ru.retirement: Cats will never retire due to a permanent condition
ru.retirement_tooltip: When this setting is off, cats with permanent conditions will choose whether or not they want to retire
ru.become_mediator: Allow warriors and elders to choose to become mediators
ru.become_mediator_tooltip: Warriors and elders will have a chance to become mediators upon moonskip.
ru.affair: Allow cats to breed with cats that aren't their mates
ru.affair_tooltip: This will allow mated and unmated cats to have kits with other cats they are not mated with. This includes, but is not limited to, affairs/cheating.
ru.same sex birth_tooltip: Allow all cats to get pregnant despite their gender and all couples to birth kittens despite same-sex status.
ru.same sex adoption_tooltip: If same-sex birth is disabled, this option greatly increases the chances of same-sex couples adopting.
ru.single parentage: Allow cats to have kittens with an unknown second parent
ru.single parentage_tooltip: Allow cats to have kittens with an unknown second biological parent. The cat will be listed as the only biological parent.
ru.romantic with former mentor: Allow romantic interactions with former mentors
ru.romantic with former mentor_tooltip: Allows mentors and the cats they trained to be romantic after they become warriors.
ru.first cousin mates: Allow first cousins to be mates and have romantic interactions
ru.first cousin mates_tooltip: Allows cats with the same grandparents but different parents to become mates.
ru.by-status_tooltip: The Clan will be fed according to their status. Priority is determined by age within statuses.
ru.younger first_tooltip: The youngest members of the Clan are fed first
ru.less nutrition first_tooltip: The hungriest cats are fed first, then the rest are fed according to their status.
ru.hunter first_tooltip: Proficient hunters are fed first, then the rest are fed according to status.
ru.sick\/injured first_tooltip: Any injured or sick cats are fed first to help them regain their strength, then the rest are fed according to status.
ru.more experience first_tooltip: The most experienced members of the Clan are fed first.
ru.ration prey_tooltip: Healthy warriors will only eat half the food they need, even if there is enough for the Clan.
ru.business as usual_tooltip: The Clan has no specific focus and won't get any bonuses.
ru.hunting_tooltip: The Clan will focus on hunting: each working warrior (including deputy and leader) and each working apprentice will gather additional prey on each moonskip.
ru.herb gathering_tooltip: The Clan will focus on herb gathering: each medicine cat and medicine cat apprentice will gather additional herbs on each moonskip due to extra help from the warriors.
ru.threaten outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with cats outside of the Clan decreases due to intentionally threatening behavior from the warriors.
ru.seek outsiders_tooltip: The relationship with cats outside of the Clan increases as the warriors make efforts to sow seeds of friendship.
ru.rest and recover_tooltip: The Clan will take more care and time in their tasks and therefore the rate of injuries, illnesses and outbreaks will be reduced.
ru.sabotage other clans_tooltip: Your mediators and warriors work together to undermine the other Clans. Only available if you have a working mediator. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
ru.aid other clans_tooltip: Your mediators and warriors work together to help the other Clans with whatever they need. Only available if you have a working mediator. Selecting this will also allow you to choose which Clans you target.
ru.raid other clans_tooltip: Your warriors begin crossing borders for resources. Prey and herbs will greatly increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will increase and the relationship with other Clans decrease. You will be able to choose which Clans you target.
ru.hoarding_tooltip: Your warriors begin stockpiling as many resources as they can get their paws on, regardless of their own safety. Prey and herbs will increase each moonskip, but injuries and illnesses will also increase.
